audit: LEXIGEN v5 Task 10 causal audit R1
scientific_interpretation: The frozen Task-10 causal-transfer result survives as evidence that transfer memory selected a useful exact graph-search mechanism unavailable to the preregistered no-transfer controls. The 14x headline is not evidence of a novel or state-of-the-art vertex-cover algorithm: a post-hoc established-style coloring-bound bitset clique/MIS baseline is about 4.5x faster than the sealed Lexigen solver and about 61x faster than the benchmark PySAT reference. The separate TM-BFR reimplementation still achieves 6.16x over PySAT and all stress cases remain exact, supporting mechanism-level reproducibility within the same research process.
claim_boundary: Preserve Task 10 as one internal causal-transfer success. Do not claim algorithmic novelty, state-of-the-art vertex cover, world-level AI breakthrough, or a passing v5 campaign.
